note.title: DNA, chromosomes, genes and alleles
note.overview: Genetic information is stored in DNA; chromosomes are long coiled DNA molecules and genes are sections that code for proteins.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for dna, chromosomes, genes and alleles.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: DNA has bases A, T, C and G; A pairs with T and C with G.
Chromosome contains many genes; an allele is a version of a gene; genome is all genetic material.
Most human body cells have 46 chromosomes in 23 pairs; gametes have 23 single chromosomes.
